description.detail: Target-disease was rebuilt from the release's disease rows joined to the kinase slice (target.fam='Kinase', 635 targets) through t2tc and protein, with slice, identity and aggregation declared. The graph grew from 9,519 nodes / 37,325 edges to 10,088 / 41,371, and associated_with from 11,384 to 15,430. Of the old pairs 11,378 are reproduced exactly, 4,052 are new and 6 are lost: MONDO:0011895 and MONDO:0010408 rows carrying neither mondoid nor a namespaced did in the raw table.
